Messages.Author: devilwithcape
Messages.Body:
Here is the situation. I have Lazvernius (sp?) which allows me to
play Framing an Ancient Grudge on Sir Walter Nash. I then banish Sir
Walter Nash, who is my predator's minion. On his next turn he re-
influences Nash out. This is Nash was the exact same card I banished,
not an additional copy in my predator's crypt. When he comes back
into play, does he regain his title?

Thanks in advanced

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Apr 1, 9:43 am, devilwithcape


No.

http://white-wolf.com/vtes/?line=rulings

# A Banished vampire will remember all effects that had been applied
to him, just as contested vampires do. This includes gained or lost
titles, etc. [RTR 20000501]
